author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
There are experts in building AI and there are experts in using AI.  Rarely are they the same person. 

The best F1 drivers don't build his own car.

reshared_post.author_headline: Principal Security Engineer & AI Security Researcher | Claude Certified Architect | AWS Machine Learning Engineer & Solutions Architect | Deep Learning | Mechanistic Interpretability | AI Architect
reshared_post.reshared_text:
I see a lot of people talking about AI as "experts" but not many people actually sharing notebooks or projects.

This leads me to believe that a lot of people with AI in their titles have never touched PyTorch and think "prompting" Gemini makes you an expert. 🤔

edit: I'm using PyTorch as an example framework - the idea is that although effective prompting can be a science - prompting alone doesn't make someone an expert with AI in my opinion.
